boundedVocabulary.rule: No numerical precision is manufactured anywhere in this artifact. No percentage-complete, no duration, no effort estimate, no probability. Every level is a bounded classification backed by a named piece of recorded evidence.

riskLevelMeanings.NONE: No recorded mechanism by which this axis can bite in this grouping.
